name: Baidu
summary:
Baidu is the Chinese search portal at baidu.com. The paw-print tab icon is what browsers request for that homepage, and the file measured here is the one the host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against baidu.com. HTML came from https://www.baidu.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://www.baidu.com/favicon.ico; icon any → https://www.baidu.com/favicon.ico; apple-touch-icon-precomposed → https://psstatic.cdn.bcebos.com/video/wiseindex/aa6eef91f8b5b1a33b454c401_1660835115000.png.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.baidu.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 16958 bytes. Directory sizes: 64×64.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://psstatic.cdn.bcebos.com/video/wiseindex/aa6eef91f8b5b1a33b454c401_1660835115000.png, measured at 1024×1024 png.

Brand colour #ffffff comes from the theme-color meta tag.

Largest measured bitmap: png-1024x1024-01.png at 1024×1024 (png, 11615 bytes) from https://psstatic.cdn.bcebos.com/video/wiseindex/aa6eef91f8b5b1a33b454c401_1660835115000.png.
